about: Manual corrections of the Qwen2.5 IT/FR translations of the QA v2 eval items (after fix_eval), by the assistant on 2026-11-11 ~22:00. All 101 kept items were read in IT and FR; listed strings replace broken MT (English leftovers, wrong words such as 'Merci-beaucoup' for Thanksgiving, Spanish words, grammar) and two answer leaks (f00489 'sistema digerente', f00916 FR 'chenille'). Unlisted strings were judged acceptable. DE/ES were NOT reviewed (zero-shot, machine translation).
